db-bench-press: Feet planted. Lower deep, press up and slightly in.
incline-db-press: 30° bench. Deep stretch at the bottom, drive up.
low-to-high-cable-fly: Pulleys low. Sweep the hands up and together to chin height.
machine-chest-press: Handles at mid-chest. Press out, control the way back.
band-assisted-pull-ups: Band under the knees or feet. Full hang, chin over the bar.
chest-supported-db-row: Chest on the bench. Pull to the hips, pause and squeeze at the top.
close-grip-lat-pulldown: Neutral handle. Full stretch at the top, elbows to ribs.
pull-ups: Strict: full hang, chin over the bar. Crisp reps, never grinding.
single-arm-cable-row: Stretch forward, then pull the elbow to the hip.
straight-arm-pulldown: Arms straight, slight hinge. Sweep the bar to the thighs.
weighted-pull-ups: Dip belt. Full hang, chin over the bar.
cable-lateral-raise: Cable behind the body. Lead with the elbow to shoulder height.
db-lateral-raise: Lead with the elbows to shoulder height. No swing.
face-pulls: Rope to the eyebrows, elbows high, pull the ends apart.
machine-shoulder-press: Back supported. Two seconds down, stop just above the shoulders.
reverse-pec-deck: Chest on the pad. Sweep back to the sides, squeeze the rear delts.
seated-db-shoulder-press: Back on the bench, no arching. Lower to ear level, press up.
bayesian-cable-curl: Face away from a low cable, arm behind the body. Curl from the stretch.
cable-curl: Elbows pinned, stand tall. Curl to the chest, lower slowly.
hammer-curl: Thumbs up, elbows at the sides. No swing.
incline-db-curl: 45° bench, arms hang behind the body. Slow 3-second lower.
preacher-curl: Armpits on the pad. Full stretch at the bottom, no bounce.
ez-bar-skull-crusher: Lower behind the head for more stretch. Elbows stay in.
overhead-cable-extension: Face away from a low pulley. Elbows by the ears, stretch, extend.
rope-pushdown: Elbows pinned to the ribs. Spread the rope at the bottom.
ab-wheel-rollout: From the knees. Brace hard, stop before the back arches.
bicycle-crunch: Slow. Opposite elbow to knee, other leg long.
bird-dog: Reach the opposite arm and leg long. Pause 2 sec, hips level.
bird-dog-plank: From a high plank, lift the opposite arm and leg. No twist.
cable-crunch: Kneel, rope by the ears. Crunch down, rounding the upper spine.
dead-bug: Low back pressed down. Reach the opposite arm and leg out, switch.
hanging-knee-to-elbow-twist: Hang still. Knees up and across toward the opposite elbow.
hanging-leg-raise: No swinging. Raise the legs, curl the pelvis toward the ribs.
hollow-body-hold: Low back flat, arms overhead, legs low. Bend the knees if it lifts.
l-sit: Shoulders pushed down, legs level. Tuck the knees if you must.
pallof-press: Stand side-on. Press straight out and back, resist the twist.
plank: Forearms down, plate on the upper back. Glutes tight, no sag.
russian-twist: Lean back 45°, feet up, plate at the chest. Rotate slowly.
side-plank-with-reach: Side plank. Reach the top arm under and through, then to the ceiling.
suitcase-carry: One heavy DB at one side. Walk tall without leaning, then switch.
superman-hold: Face down. Lift arms and legs a little, hold 3 sec. Look at the floor.
toe-touches: Legs straight up. Reach for the toes, shoulders off the floor.
glute-bridge: On your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes 3 sec at the top.
hip-thrust: Upper back on the bench. Pause 2 sec at the top, chin tucked.
bulgarian-split-squat: Rear foot on the bench. Upright torso, drop straight down.
leg-extension: Sit back, pad on the shins. Squeeze 1 sec at the top.
leg-press: Feet mid-plate. Stop before the hips lift off the pad.
lying-hamstring-curl: Hips pressed down. Curl up, 3-second lower.
standing-calf-raise: Full stretch at the bottom, 2-sec pause, rise high.
copenhagen-plank: Top leg on the bench, side plank on the forearm. Hips high.
barbell-bench-press: Shoulder blades pinned. Bar to the lower chest, press up over the eyes.
seated-cable-row: Sit tall, knees soft. Pull the handle to the belly, no rocking.
hack-squat: Back flat on the pad. Lower deep, drive up through the whole foot.
reverse-lunge: DBs at the sides. Step back, drop the knee, drive up off the front heel.
seated-leg-curl: Thigh pad snug, lean forward a little. Curl fully, 3-sec lower.
cable-pull-through: Face away, rope between the legs. Hips back, then squeeze them through.
seated-calf-raise: Pad on the lower thighs. Full stretch, rise high, 2-sec pause.
tibialis-raise: Back on the wall, heels a foot out. Toes up high, lower slowly.
smith-bench-press: Bar meets lower chest. Lower under control, press without bouncing.
incline-barbell-bench-press: 30° bench. Bar to upper chest, press back over the shoulders.
decline-barbell-bench-press: Feet locked in. Bar to lower chest, press straight up.
close-grip-bench-press: Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked. Bar to lower chest, lock out.
smith-incline-press: 30° bench, bar meets upper chest. Lower slow, press without bouncing.
db-floor-press: Knees bent. Lower till upper arms touch the floor, pause, press.
seal-row: Lie face down on the high bench. Row the bar up to the bench.
seated-barbell-press: Back on the pad. Bar from collarbone to straight over the head.
smith-machine-shoulder-press: Back on the pad, bar in front of the face. Lower to chin, press up.
standing-barbell-press: Glutes tight, ribs down. Bar straight up, head through at the top.
push-up: Body in one line. Chest to a fist from the floor, press up.
decline-push-up: Feet on the bench, hips level. Lower the head toward the floor.
deficit-push-up: Hands on dumbbells, wrists straight. Lower past the hands.
pike-push-up: Hips high. Lower the head just in front of the hands, press up.
plank-shoulder-tap: High plank, feet wide. Tap the other shoulder, hips still.
mountain-climber: High plank, hips level. Drive one knee to the chest at a time.
incline-db-fly: 30° bench, soft elbows. Open wide, hug the weights over the face.
pec-deck-fly: Back on the pad. Bring the handles together, slow on the way back.
cable-crossover-fly: Pulleys at shoulder height. Soft elbows, hug until the hands meet.
standing-cable-press: Split stance, ribs down. Press forward and together.
incline-machine-press: Handles at the upper chest. Press up and in, slow on the way back.
chin-ups: Underhand, shoulder width. Full hang, chest to the bar.
neutral-grip-pull-ups: Palms facing on parallel handles. Full hang, elbows to ribs.
negative-pull-ups: Step up to chin over the bar. Lower for 3 to 5 seconds.
scapular-pull-ups: Arms straight. Pull the shoulders down and back, lower slowly.
assisted-pull-up-machine: Knees on the pad. Full hang, chin over the handles.
lat-pulldown: Hands outside the shoulders. Bar to the upper chest, chest up.
underhand-lat-pulldown: Palms toward you. Bar to the upper chest, elbows down and in.
single-arm-lat-pulldown: Reach up for a full stretch, pull the elbow to the hip.
band-lat-pulldown: Kneel under a high anchor. Elbows down to the ribs, chest up.
hanging-knee-raise: Hang still. Knees up past the hips, tilt the pelvis. Lower slowly.
toes-to-bar: Straight arms press the bar down. Toes to the bar, no kip.
wide-grip-seated-cable-row: Overhand, wide bar. Pull to the lower chest, elbows out at 45°.
machine-row: Chest on the pad, handles at chest height. Squeeze the blades back.
iso-lateral-row: Chest on the pad. Row one or both arms, elbows back, pause and squeeze.
chest-supported-t-bar-row: Chest on the pad, feet planted. Pull to the lower chest, lower slowly.
one-arm-db-row: Hand and knee on the bench, back flat. Pull the DB to the hip.
inverted-row: Body straight, heels down. Pull the chest to the bar.
suspension-trainer-row: Lean back, body straight. Pull the hands to the ribs.
cable-pullover: Head to a low pulley. Sweep the rope over to the hips, arms straight.
db-pullover: One DB in both hands. Lower behind the head, ribs down, pull back up.
back-extension: Pad below the hips. Lower with a flat back, rise to a straight line.
stability-ball-back-extension: Hips on the ball, feet on the wall. Lift to a straight line, no arching.
band-curl: Stand on the band, elbows pinned. Curl up, lower slowly.
barbell-curl: Elbows at the sides, body still. Curl to the chest, lower slowly.
ez-bar-curl: Grip the inner angles, elbows pinned. Curl up, no leaning back.
reverse-curl: Palms down, wrists straight, elbows pinned. Curl up, lower slowly.
db-curl: Elbows at the sides, palms up. Curl to the shoulders, lower in 2-3 s.
concentration-curl: Elbow on the inner thigh. Curl to the shoulder, squeeze, lower slowly.
db-preacher-curl: Armpit on the pad, one arm. Full stretch, no bounce, slow lower.
spider-curl: Chest on a 45° bench, arms hanging. Curl up hard, lower slowly.
high-cable-curl: Arms out at shoulder height. Curl the handles to the ears.
cable-rope-hammer-curl: Rope, thumbs up, elbows pinned. Curl the rope ends to the shoulders.
machine-biceps-curl: Elbows in line with the pivot. Curl up, lower for 3 seconds.
band-overhead-extension: Band under the back foot. Elbows by the ears, lower behind, extend.
cable-kickback: Low pulley, hinge forward. Upper arm still, extend straight back.
db-kickback: Knee and hand on the bench. Upper arm level, extend back, squeeze.
db-lying-extension: Palms facing. Lower beside the ears, extend without flaring.
db-overhead-extension: Sit tall. Cup one dumbbell, lower behind the head, elbows in.
ez-bar-overhead-extension: Sit tall. Lower the bar behind the head, elbows in, extend.
single-arm-db-overhead-extension: Elbow up by the head. Lower behind the head, extend fully.
reverse-grip-pushdown: Palms up, elbows tight to the ribs. Push to lockout, slow up.
straight-bar-pushdown: Elbows pinned, wrists straight. Push the bar to the thighs.
single-arm-cable-pushdown: Elbow pinned, other hand on the stack. Push to lockout.
arnold-press: Palms to you at the chin. Turn them out as you press up.
standing-db-shoulder-press: Glutes and abs tight. Press straight up, no leaning back.
landmine-press: Staggered stance, bar at the shoulder. Press up and forward.
seated-db-lateral-raise: Sit tall on the bench end. Raise to shoulder height, no swing.
lean-away-lateral-raise: Hold the upright, lean away. Raise from the hip to shoulder height.
band-lateral-raise: Stand on the band. Raise to shoulder height, lower slowly.
machine-lateral-raise: Chest on the pad. Push the pads out with the elbows.
plate-front-raise: Plate at 3 and 9 o'clock. Raise to eye level, no leaning back.
barbell-upright-row: Hands shoulder-width. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.
cable-upright-row: Low pulley, rope. Pull the elbows out to chest height, no higher.
band-pull-apart: Arms straight at shoulder height. Pull the band to the chest, squeeze.
bent-over-db-reverse-fly: Hinge near flat, back neutral. Raise out wide, pinkies leading.
incline-db-reverse-fly: Chest on the bench. Raise out wide to shoulder height, pause.
cable-reverse-fly: Cables crossed at shoulder height. Sweep back wide, arms long.
incline-y-raise: Chest on the bench, thumbs up. Raise in a Y to ear height. Go light.
cable-external-rotation: Elbow pinned to the side. Rotate the hand out, slow back.
side-lying-db-external-rotation: Elbow on the hip at 90°. Rotate the dumbbell up slowly.
seated-dip-machine: Sit tall. Press down to lockout, hands back up to chest level.
triceps-extension-machine: Elbows on the pivot. Extend fully, slow return.
db-split-squat: Long split stance, DBs at the sides. Drop straight down, torso upright.
walking-lunge: Long steps, DBs at the sides. Back knee near the floor, drive forward.
bodyweight-reverse-lunge: Hands on hips. Step back, drop the back knee, drive up the front heel.
step-up: Whole foot on the bench. Drive up through the heel, no push from below.
goblet-squat: DB at the chest. Sit between the heels, elbows inside the knees.
landmine-squat: Bar end at the chest, lean into it. Sit down between the heels.
smith-machine-squat: Feet a little ahead of the bar. Sit to parallel, back tall.
pistol-squat: Free leg straight out front. Sit all the way down, heel flat.
sissy-squat: On the toes, hold a support. Knees forward, lean back, hips straight.
wall-sit: Back flat on the wall, thighs level, shins vertical. Hold and breathe.
single-leg-extension: One leg, pad on the low shin. Squeeze at the top, lower slowly.
single-leg-press: One foot mid-plate. Keep the hips down, press through the heel.
leg-press-calf-raise: Balls of the feet on the plate edge, knees still. Full stretch, push up.
cable-leg-curl: Strap on the ankle, hold the frame. Thigh still, curl heel to glute.
stability-ball-leg-curl: Heels on the ball, hips up. Roll the ball in, keep the hips high.
nordic-curl: Heels hooked, hips straight. Lower as slowly as you can, push back up.
db-romanian-deadlift: Soft knees, flat back. Hips back, DBs down the thighs to the stretch.
single-leg-rdl: DB in the opposite hand, hips square. Back leg and torso move as one.
bodyweight-calf-raise: On a step, hand on a wall. Full stretch, 2-sec pause up top.
single-leg-db-calf-raise: One foot on a step, DB in that hand. Full stretch, 2-sec pause up top.
smith-calf-raise: Bar on the back, balls of feet on a step. Straight knees, 2-sec pause.
band-pull-through: Band low behind, between the legs. Hips back, then drive them through.
barbell-glute-bridge: Bar over the hips, feet flat. Drive up, squeeze 2 sec, ribs down.
cable-glute-kickback: Strap on the ankle, hold the frame. Kick back and up, no back arch.
machine-hip-thrust: Back on the pad, belt over the hips. Drive up, pause 2 sec, ribs down.
single-leg-glute-bridge: One foot down, other knee to chest. Hips level, squeeze at the top.
single-leg-hip-thrust: Upper back on the bench, one foot down. Hips level, pause at the top.
kneeling-side-plank: Knees bent and stacked, elbow under shoulder. Hips up in line, hold.
stir-the-pot: Forearms on the ball, body straight. Small circles, hips stay still.
stability-ball-rollout: Kneel, forearms on the ball. Roll out, ribs down, back before it sags.
band-pallof-press: Band at chest height, side-on. Press out, hold a second, don't twist.
half-kneeling-pallof-press: Inside knee down, glute tight. Press out from the chest, no twist.
cable-woodchop: Cable high to one side. Pull across and down to the far hip, turning.
captains-chair-knee-raise: Back flat on the pad. Knees to chest, curl the pelvis, lower slowly.
captains-chair-leg-raise: Back flat on the pad. Straight legs to hip height, lower slowly.
crunch: Knees bent, hands at temples. Curl ribs to hips, don't pull the head.
decline-crunch: Feet hooked. Curl up until the low back lifts, lower slowly.
lying-leg-raise: Hands under hips. Lower straight legs only while the back stays flat.
reverse-crunch: Knees at 90°. Curl the hips off the floor toward the ribs. No swing.
